description: This PHP class defines an abstract base writer for exporting spreadsheet data, including configuration options like chart inclusion, formula pre-calculation, and disk caching, along with methods to manage file handling and writer flags.
external_files: php://scheme (used in parse_url for scheme detection)

classes.name: BaseWriter
classes.description: Abstract class providing foundational functionality for spreadsheet file writers, including configuration of charts, formulas, disk caching, and file handling.

methods.name: getIncludeCharts
methods.description: Returns whether charts should be included in the output.

methods.name: setIncludeCharts
methods.description: Sets whether to include charts in the output.

methods.name: getPreCalculateFormulas
methods.description: Returns whether formulas are pre-calculated before saving.

methods.name: setPreCalculateFormulas
methods.description: Sets whether to pre-calculate formulas when saving.

methods.name: getUseDiskCaching
methods.description: Returns whether disk caching is enabled.

methods.name: setUseDiskCaching
methods.description: Enables or disables disk caching and optionally sets caching directory.

methods.name: getDiskCachingDirectory
methods.description: Returns the directory used for disk caching.

methods.name: openFileHandle
methods.description: Opens a file handle for writing, managing resource and scheme (e.g., s3).

methods.name: maybeCloseFileHandle
methods.description: Closes the open file handle if it was opened by this class.
